title: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES PP2 2023 Term 3 SET 1
text:
ENVIRONMENTAL AND CRE ACTIVITIES - CBC PRE-
PRIMARY TWO P2 TERM 3 EXAM
QUESTIONS
 1. Answer these questions
 A goat has..................................legs
 A sheep gives us..........................
 (milk, wool)
 A cat catches........................
 (rat, fly)
 A ripe banan is.............................in colour (green, yellow, blue, red)
 2. Read and colour the fruits
 3. Name the kitchen utensils
 (pot, glass, pan, jug, cup)
 4. Match God's creation with their name
 (Hill, Star, Moon)
Marking Scheme
 1. 4 legs
 wool
 rat
 yellow
 2. colour the fruits any colour is correct
 3. pan
 cup
 pot
 jug
 glass
 4. star - 1st image
 moon - 2nd image
 hill - 3rd image
